news.headline: Alvin Kamara says he will play Sunday
news.summary: Kamara hurt his knee in August and was told it would take about six weeks. He practiced in full two days in a row and said Thursday that he feels good and is playing at Baltimore.

news.headline: Chris Olave turns up on the injury report
news.summary: Receiver Chris Olave and pass rusher Chase Young were added to Thursday's injury report, Olave with a hamstring and Young with a calf, and both did part of practice. Alvin Kamara did all of practice for a second day in a row, three days before the Saints play at Baltimore.

news.headline: Saints sign a new man to snap on kicks
news.summary: Zach Wood, who snaps the ball on field goals and punts, strained his calf and is expected to be out about a month. The Saints tried out three snappers Thursday and signed Scott Daly, who has played 76 games for Detroit and Chicago.

news.headline: Florida will wait on Eric Singleton for Saturday
news.summary: Florida listed receiver Eric Singleton as questionable on Wednesday for the game at Auburn, the school he played for last season. He hurt his ankle on September 5 and will dress and try to play, and lineman Emmanuel Oyebadejo is questionable too.

news.headline: Aaron Philo makes his first SEC start Saturday
news.summary: Philo has thrown for 517 yards and five touchdowns in Florida's two wins and has completed more than 76 percent of his passes. Saturday at Auburn is his first road start and his first game against an SEC team.

news.headline: Sumrall goes to Auburn, where his family has ties
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall grew up in Alabama and his wife went to Auburn, so he was asked about family cheering against him Saturday. He said Florida pays his mortgage, and the Gators are going for their first 3-0 start since 2019.

news.headline: Sam Leavitt practices and is upgraded to questionable
news.summary: LSU's quarterback practiced with the team Thursday morning after being limited on Wednesday. The SEC report moved him from doubtful to questionable for Saturday night at Ole Miss.

news.headline: Ole Miss sues an LSU player over a broken deal
news.summary: Ole Miss is suing LSU defensive end Princewill Umanmielen, who left Ole Miss in January and followed coach Lane Kiffin to Baton Rouge. Court papers were handed to him Tuesday outside the LSU football building, and Ole Miss is asking for about $550,000.

news.headline: Lane Kiffin says Ed Orgeron is doing better
news.summary: Orgeron, who helps LSU with recruiting and defense, has been away from the team for about a month with an illness. Kiffin said Monday that it was scary for a while and that Orgeron is feeling better and still checking in on the team.

news.headline: Dickson Agu honored after a 14-tackle game
news.summary: Agu made 14 tackles in Saturday's win over South Alabama, the most by a Tulane player in a game since 2023. On Tuesday he was named one of six national comeback players of the week, a year after a knee injury cost him most of last season.

news.headline: Two Tulane players hurt with Kansas State next
news.summary: Coach Will Hall said Tuesday that linebacker Chris Rodgers is getting a second opinion and that the team is still finding out how long tight end Ty Thompson will be out. Tulane plays Saturday morning at Kansas State, which is 2-0.

news.headline: Jaylin Lucas honored by the American Conference
news.summary: The conference put Lucas on its weekly honor roll Monday for his 214 yards and a touchdown against South Alabama. He averaged 19.5 yards a carry, a conference record for a player with at least 10 carries in a game.
